newsitem.title: UK: LME ALUMINIUM RECOVERS SLIGHTLY IN EVENING TRADE.
newsitem.headline: LME ALUMINIUM RECOVERS SLIGHTLY IN EVENING TRADE.

text.p: Aluminium prices recovered slightly in London Metal Exchange evening trading on Tuesday after threatening to dip under $1,700 earlier.
The light metal was caught up in a bout of liquidation which caused volatility in most markets but serious price falls were avoided when along with copper it found late buying.
However later the copper price barely moved from its $2,278 kerb close while aluminuium recovered to $1,722/$1,724 up $7 from the kerb by 1800 GMT.
